articles.title: OPPO Find N6 foldable smartphone to receive global release
articles.description: OPPO has officially announced that its upcoming Find N6 foldable smartphone will be launched globally alongside its Chinese release. The previous model, despite similar statements, was eventually sold only in Asia.
